summary: P01 V2.47.232 fixes the Owner-reported severe Quick Open search rendering defect on SubjectPageChrome surfaces. Subject pages loaded quick-open.js without quick-open.css, causing result buttons to enter the masthead search form flex flow. The fix loads shared quick-open.css on subject pages, hardens desktop overlay geometry, preserves mobile fixed-sheet behavior, and adds a regression contract requiring every Quick Open runtime surface to load its CSS. No IA/Data/Schema/Auth/Updater/Provider/Production semantic change. Production remains Owner-manual.
